## Problem and behavior

Describe the user-visible change and its reason.

## Verification

List commands run and meaningful output checks. Include screenshots for UI changes.

- [ ] Browser-local processing is preserved; no document data is logged, stored or sent.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, including accessibility and network checks.
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG describe the actual behavior.
- [ ] No private PDFs, secrets or generated test artifacts are committed.
